current.text: Projected starting five: Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, LeBron James and Joel Embiid.
His usage is expected to drop because Jaylen Brown, LeBron James and a healthier Embiid share the ball with him. One expert projects his usage to fall from 30 to under 27.
Experts expect his minutes to dip a little from last season's 38 per game. Nick Nurse might trim them, and Embiid and Anfernee Simons could cut them to about 36.5.
He is expected to move toward a shooting guard role, with LeBron James handling more of the playmaking. That puts his assists at risk.
Experts expect his steals, blocks and free throw volume to come down. They see last season as close to his best case in every category.
His only top 10 finish came last season, while Paul George and Embiid missed many games.

Experts call him a fade at his rank of 8. They see him as a late first or early second round player in categories, with a likely finish around 15th to 19th. Jamal Murray, Austin Reaves, LaMelo Ball and Karl-Anthony Towns could finish ahead of him.
In an expert auction mock he went for 40 USD, which matched the expert's price.
Philadelphia is projected to win about 51 to 52 games. The expert expects growing pains in October and November and load management for the stars.
Philadelphia plays 3, 4 and 4 games in our playoff weeks (March 28 end) and has only 13 back-to-backs this season. One note says three of them fall in the fantasy playoffs.

durable.text: Steals are a real league outlier for him. Points, FT%, threes and assists are also clearly strong.
His weakest categories are FG%, rebounds and blocks.
Described as a very good shooter.
Experts disagree on his defense. One says he has improved a lot on defense. Another does not think he is a strong defender and calls his defensive stats uncertain.
He has missed more games over the last few years than people think and has had injuries at times.

note: Both sites rank him 8. Yahoo's average cost is 56.5 USD and ESPN's is 48 USD, while our league paid 37 USD last season and an expert auction mock landed at 40 USD. Experts expect a finish around 15th to 19th, so let others pay first-round money and bid only up to about 40 to 45 USD. He fits any build as a steals, points, FT% and threes source. Early in the season, check his usage and assists next to Brown, LeBron and Embiid, his minutes under Nurse, and whether last season's 1.9 steals holds up.
